text:
Vasily Podkolzin has been one of Edmonton's best stories. The former Canuck has nine goals and 15 points in 19 games, he's on the second power-play unit, and the Oilers have 61.5% of the five-on-five expected goals with him on the ice, about 20 points better than the team does without him. Canucks Army put it plainly: he "has more than found a home in Edmonton."

He also made headlines for the fight. Against Anaheim he went after Drew Helleson for a hit on Connor McDavid and was given a game misconduct, a call McDavid told The Athletic he'd never seen before.

Now the caution. He's shooting 24% against 14% last season, and the Oilers have scored 8.2 more goals than their chances deserved in his minutes. Both will come down, and his last ten games (three points, ice time down more than three minutes) may be the start of that. The good news is the chances are real: 1.14 expected goals per 60 is a career high. Our range has him around 26 goals.
headline: Vasily Podkolzin has found a home, and a hot stick
